You turned on a source, but Android hasn\'t given Zuri notification access yet. Nothing is captured until you allow it.
Android blocks this setting for apps installed outside Google Play. Open App info, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Access is allowed, but the listener isn\'t running. This can happen after an update or when the phone saves battery.
Battery optimisation is on for Zuri. On some phones this stops the listener; setting Zuri to \"Unrestricted\" helps.
Turn on a source below to start. Zuri reads nothing until you do.
Notifications are ignored until you resume. Nothing is stored while paused.
Stop reading notifications from every source
Photos and files as labels only
Keep and show messages, but never analyse them
They\'re removed from this phone and can\'t be recovered. The source stays on, so new messages will still be captured.

Zuri sees what your notifications show, nothing more: no history from before today, no photos or files, nothing from muted chats, and nothing an app hides from its notifications. Messages you read on a computer first may never notify.
The text of notifications from the apps you turn on: who sent a message, the chat name and the message itself.
Every other app\'s notifications are dropped unread. Photos, voice notes and files never reach Zuri.
Into an encrypted database on this phone. This version of Zuri has no internet access, so nothing leaves the phone.
Pause or turn off any source, exclude a chat, or delete messages at any time. You can also withdraw access in Android settings.
Android will now open its Notification access screen. Turn on Zuri there, then come back.
